Olivia (ACME): Hey team — after our Okta->SCIM push this morning ~50 users suddenly lost the ProductAdmin role. Not seeing obvious failures in our Okta logs. Can you check provisioning?
Priya (CS): Sorry to hear that — can you paste one affected user's SCIM payload and the provisioning webhook response?
Olivia (ACME): Here's a redacted example for jdoe: ```{"userName":"jdoe@acme.com","externalId":"u-1234","groups":[{"display":"engineering","value":"g-88"}],"manager":{"displayName":"svc-billing","externalId":"svc_1234"}}``` Our mapping rule uses group->role but we also have a manager-based role inheritance rule in the console. The webhook response showed 200 but role not applied.
Priya (CS): Hmm 200 from SCIM server doesn't mean mapping succeeded. Can you share the provisioning audit ID?
Olivia (ACME): audit=prov_20250912_44. Web UI shows these users as "active" but roles empty.
Okta Sync Bot: provision.prov_20250912_44 status=200, updated=50 users, warnings=12
Ethan (SRE): Tagging infra — quick question: are those manager.externalId values recently changed to include the svc_ prefix?
Olivia (ACME): Yes, we rotated service accounts last week, new externalIds start with "svc_". Previously managers were human ids like "u-5678".
Marco (Eng): Can you paste the platform-provisioner logs for that audit id? I want to see how the group-to-role-mapper handled manager lookup.
Priya (CS): Copying relevant snippet from ACME logs (redacted): ```2025-09-12T15:12:03Z ERROR provisioner: mapper.lookup_by_externalid externalId=svc_1234 results=0 -> treating manager as groupId; 2025-09-12T15:12:03Z WARN provisioner: group-mapper resolved 0 groups, removing inferred roles for user=jdoe```
Marco (Eng): Ah — looks like a logic bug: manager.externalId is being fed into the group lookup path without checking if the externalId type maps to a service account vs group. If the lookup returns 0 we silently remove any roles that were previously inferred. That's the regression.
Ethan (SRE): Repro steps (quick): 1) Create user with manager.externalId="svc_xxx" 2) Provision via SCIM with mapper rules: manager->inherits manager's groups 3) Observe provisioning log: mapper.lookup_by_externalid returns 0 4) Role inference removed.
Olivia (ACME): Is there a safe workaround? We can't change Okta mapping immediately for 2k users.
Priya (CS): Short-term workaround: in Console > Mappings, change the manager-based rule to "fallback: preserve existing roles on lookup miss" (we have that toggle but it's off by default). That will stop the automatic removal. I'll send exact steps.
Priya (CS): Steps: Settings -> Provisioning -> Role mappings -> Edit manager->inherit rule -> toggle "Don't remove roles if lookup fails" -> Save.
Olivia (ACME): Done, toggled it. Will it re-apply roles for the 50 users or just stop future removals?
Marco (Eng): That toggle prevents removal on misses but doesn't re-add roles. To re-apply you can re-run a full re-sync or use the one-off "recalculate roles" job (API: POST /admin/provisioning/recalculate?audit=prov_20250912_44). We're going to avoid a full destructive update until we patch.
Ethan (SRE): We traced root cause: the lookup service treats externalId tokens with underscore underscore-containing prefixes as non-user ids and returns empty; then the mapper treats empty as signal to clear inherited roles. Fix: ensure mapper differentiates group/service account types and not clear on miss.
Marco (Eng): I've opened PR #4092 to change behavior: if lookup returns 0, do not auto-clear roles; return a warning and keep previous role set. Also adding a diagnostic flag so admins can opt into strict enforcement.
Priya (CS): ETA for deploy?
Marco (Eng): Targeting canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC, full rollout 2025-09-14 02:00 UTC pending smoke tests.
Olivia (ACME): Appreciate it. We'll run the recalculate job after you confirm deploy. Any permanent fix to avoid needing recalc?
Marco (Eng): We'll add a conservative reconciliation pass during deploy that will re-evaluate manager inheritance without removing roles on ambiguous lookups and will emit a report for you. That should restore most users automatically.
Priya (CS): Action items: (1) Olivia toggles the preserve-roles option — done. (2) We will not run destructive sync until PR deployed. (3) After deploy, we will run the reconciliation job and share CSV of changes. (4) CS will follow up to confirm ACME users restored.
Olivia (ACME): Thanks. Please loop me in when PR is canaried.
Ethan (SRE): Also patching logs to include lookup_reason and externalId_type to make future debugging trivial.
Marco (Eng): Noted. PR #4092 includes log tags and unit tests for manager->group mapping.
Priya (CS): I'll set a follow-up for tomorrow morning and attach the reconcile CSV when ready.
Olivia (ACME): Thanks all — saved my Friday. :relieved:
Ethan (SRE): FYI we saw 12 warnings in the audit for similar service account externalIds — those will be included in the report.
Marco (Eng): Deployed canary 2025-09-13T08:10Z — monitor logs for provision.prov_20250912_44 and ping if you still see removals.
Olivia (ACME): Canary looks good so far. I see roles reappear for ~20 users, waiting on full reconcile.
Priya (CS): Full reconcile completed 2025-09-14T04:20Z. CSV attached to ticket (internal). Final status: 50 users restored, 2 users require manual mapping because their manager externalId pointed to retired service account.
Olivia (ACME): Confirmed — all recovered except the 2 retired ones. We'll update manager values on our side. Thanks team! :tada:
